name: epipilot
description: Evidence-driven epistemic research mode for long-horizon Codex work.

interface.shortDescription: Run Codex as an evidence-driven research agent.
interface.longDescription: EpiPilot adds a durable epistemic research loop: clarify user-owned decisions, track unknowns and falsifiable hypotheses, run discriminative experiments, admit independently verified evidence, update beliefs, and replan.
defaultPrompt: Investigate this research problem with EpiPilot.
Build and test competing hypotheses for this failure.
Show the current epistemic map and next experiment.
